Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) First Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan I) (c. 600 AD)

'FOR I, THE LORD, FILL FROM HORIZON TO HORIZON; all creation is in my hand. Below the earth and above the heaven, in the sea and in the deeps of the abyss' — GOD-IS-EVERYWHERE LITANY (vv. 4-7). The divine-omnipresence-claim parallels: Psalm 139:7-12 ('Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence? If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there'); Jeremiah 23:23-24 ('Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off? Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? Do not I fill heaven and earth?'); Amos 9:2-3 ('Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down'). Meqabyan's distinctive variation: the SPATIAL-DOMAINS specifically named (below-earth + above-heaven + sea + abyss) match the four-fold cosmography of 3 Mq 1:3 the Devil's hubris-speech ('I will enter the depths of the sea; I will ascend to heaven') — the OPPOSITE of the divine-omnipresence Ṣiruṣaydan-and-Devil cannot match.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) First Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan I) (c. 600 AD)

**ETHIOPIA NAMED** (alongside Saba/Sheba + India + Nubia) — the first of two explicit Ethiopia-references in 1 Meqabyan (paired with 28:38 at γ.4.8.B-detail-wave). The mention is GEOGRAPHICALLY-IMPORTANT: Ethiopia + Saba (Sheba) + India + Nubia form the eastern + southern horizon of the Hellenistic-Aksumite world. Saba/Sheba = the Solomonic-tradition source (1 Kings 10 + 2 Chron 9 + the Tewahedo Kǝbrä Nägäśt Solomonic-dynasty claim); India = the Apostolic-mission destination (per Eusebius Hist. Eccl. 5.10 Pantaenus to India; the Thomasine tradition); Nubia = the immediate-Northern-neighbor; Ethiopia = the home of Frumentius-the-Tewahedo-founder. The geographical-self-naming of Ethiopia within the canonical Meqabyan text is a DIAGNOSTIC ETHIOPIAN-SELF-RECOGNITION moment, locating the text within the Aksumite-Ethiopian Christian self-understanding. Per memory `project_v1_terminus`: Ethiopia-named is a Tewahedo-uniqueness-angle the buyer-demo surfaces visibly.
